title: Mubatanidzwa Wakakoka Kuparadzwa
intro: Fungidzira wakavharirwa pasi pedenga rimwe chete nerakaratidzwa, asi uchisarudza kuvimbika kwakasiyana. Munhu uyu aigara pedyo nechokwadi neuporofita, asi akatendeukira kune avo vakaramba. Nyaya yavo inomira seyambiro huru yekuti kuva pedyo nekururama chete hakugone kuponesa mweya unonyengera chivimbo chako.
clues: Ndaiziva chokwadi chaiparidzwa nemurume wangu, asi handina kunyatsochitenda.
Ndakamutengesa nekutsigira vanhu vaairamba uye ndikavabatsira kuti vamurwise.
Ndinotaurwa pamwe chete nemukadzi wemumwe muporofita uyo akatengesawo, semuenzaniso kune vasingatendi.
Nyaya yangu inotaurwa muSurah At-Tahrim seyambiro yekuti hukama nevaprofita hahudziviriri.
Ndakaparara pamwe chete nevasina kururama apo Allah akaparadza vanhu vaLut, vakasara pamwe chete nevakasara.

trial.label: Kutongwa/Chiitiko
options: Akatengesa muporofita nekubatsira vasingatendi kuti vamurwise
Kanda mwana mucheche murwizi ari mudengu kuti umuponese
Vakakumbira kuti mhuru yegoridhe ivakwe panguva iyo muporofita asipo
Akapomera mushumiri akarurama mhosva yekuita zvakaipa ndokumuisa mujeri
Akatungamira hondo yenzou kuti iparadze Kaaba
trial.answer: Akatengesa muporofita nekubatsira vasingatendi kuti vamurwise

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Akaparara pamwe chete nevasingatendi pasinei nekuroora muporofita
Akaponeswa pamwe chete nevatendi uye akapinda muParadhiso nerugare
Yakashandurwa kuita mbiru sechiratidzo chezvizvarwa zvinotevera
outcome.answer: Akaparara pamwe chete nevasingatendi pasinei nekuroora muporofita

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
